name: global-search-worktree-discovery
title: Global Search and Automatic Worktree Discovery
description: Add an Orca-style global search overlay for chats, terminals, worktrees, settings, and actions, and automatically discover and display each project's Local, WSL, or SSH Git worktrees in the project sidebar.
scope: mt-project captured worktree parsing; mt-app shared Local/WSL/SSH worktree catalog, child registration, exact terminal activation, Orca sidebar integration, global jump palette, i18n/hotkeys, tests, and GitHub Actions validation/package evidence
creator: leo

meta.previous_task_audit: archived status and Actions evidence are synchronized; approved Quick Open and execution-host remote/WSL worktree discovery were omitted from implementation and are corrective scope here
meta.task_shape: single integrated task because sidebar and palette share one catalog and activation boundary
meta.worktree_scan_scope: exact added project folder as Git anchor; related worktrees only; no recursive, parent, host-wide, or unrelated repository scan
residual_risks: physical Windows UI smoke test not performed

the repository has no GPUI end-to-end window harness; pointer, backdrop, and focus paths were validated by unit contracts, existing overlay tests, source inspection, Windows compilation, and package verification
